source:
施展该法术时，你在某个表面（诸如桌面或地板）或某个能被关闭以隐藏刻纹的物件里（诸如书本或宝箱）刻画一个会释放魔法效应的刻纹。该刻纹可以覆盖直径不超过10尺的区域。如果受术的物件或表面从被施法位置被移开超过10尺，则其刻纹被破坏且法术不被触发即告终止。
结界刻纹近乎不可察觉，其需要以你的法术豁免DC进行一次成功的感知（察觉）检定才能被发现。
刻画刻纹时，你可以设定其触发条件，并从爆炸符文和法术刻纹两者中选择其一：
　　• 设定触发条件Set the Trigger。你在施法时设定结界刻纹的触发条件。刻画于表面的刻纹其最典型的触发条件包括：触碰或站立在刻纹上；拿掉覆盖在刻纹上的物件；进入刻纹一定范围。刻画在物件内的刻纹其最典型的触发条件包括：打开物件；看到该刻纹。刻纹一旦被触发，则该法术终止。
你可以进一步细化触发条件，比如设定只有特定生物种类（例如设定为只影响异怪Aberration）才能触发刻纹。你还可以为生物设置不触发刻纹的条件，诸如某人说出特定口令。
　　• 爆炸符文Explosive Runes。符文被触发时将在半径 20尺球状区域内爆发魔法能量。区域内的每个生物必须进行一次敏捷豁免。豁免失败者将受到5d8点强酸，冷冻，火焰，闪电，或雷鸣伤害（你在制造刻纹时指定），豁免成功则伤害减半。
　　• 法术刻纹Spell Glyph。作为创造符文的一部分，你可以施展一道已准备的的三环或更低环阶法术，并将其储备在所创造的刻纹中。所储备法术必须以单一生物或一个区域为目标，而被储存的法术以该方式施展时并不会立即生效。
符文被触发时，所储备的法术即刻生效。如果法术有一个目标，则以触发刻纹的生物为目标；如果法术影响一个区域，则该区域以此生物为中心；如果法术召唤敌对Hostile生物或创造伤害性质的物件或陷阱，则这些造物将显现在尽可能靠近触发者的地方并攻击它。如果法术需要专注，则其效应将在其最大持续时间内维持。
升环施法：使用的法术位每比三环高一环，此法术的爆炸符文的伤害就增加1d8。如果你创造一个法术刻纹，则其储备法术的环阶至高可以与你施放守卫刻文时使用的法术位环阶相同。
target:
When you cast this spell, you inscribe a glyph that releases a magical effect on a surface (such as a tabletop or floor) or inside an object that can be closed to conceal it (such as a book or chest). The glyph can cover an area no more than 10 feet in diameter. If the affected object or surface is moved more than 10 feet from where you cast the spell, the glyph is broken and the spell ends without being triggered.
The warding glyph is nearly imperceptible. Finding it requires a successful Wisdom (Perception) check against your spell save DC.
When you inscribe the glyph, you set its trigger and choose either Explosive Runes or a Spell Glyph:
    • Set the Trigger. You set the warding glyph's trigger when you cast the spell. Typical triggers for a glyph on a surface include touching or standing on it, removing an object covering it, or approaching within a certain distance of it. Typical triggers for a glyph inside an object include opening the object or seeing the glyph. Once the glyph is triggered, this spell ends.
You can refine the trigger, such as allowing only certain creature types to trigger the glyph (for example, affecting only Aberrations). You can also specify conditions under which a creature doesn't trigger the glyph, such as speaking a particular password.
    • Explosive Runes. When triggered, the runes erupt with magical energy in a Sphere with a 20-foot radius. Each creature in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 5d8 Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage (chosen when you create the glyph); on a successful save, it takes half as much damage.
    • Spell Glyph. As part of creating the glyph, you can cast a prepared spell of third level or lower and store it in the glyph. The stored spell must target a single creature or an area, and casting it in this way doesn't cause it to take effect immediately.
When the glyph is triggered, the stored spell takes effect immediately. If the spell has a target, it targets the creature that triggered the glyph. If it affects an area, the area is centered on that creature. If it summons Hostile creatures or creates harmful objects or traps, those creations appear as close as possible to the triggering creature and attack it. If the spell requires Concentration, its effect lasts for its full maximum duration.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: The Explosive Runes damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above third. If you create a Spell Glyph, the stored spell can be of a level up to that of the slot used to cast Glyph of Warding.
note: Same-row N370 confirms Glyph of Warding. All three bullets, both trigger categories, movement cancellation, stored-spell targeting, Concentration exception, and separate scaling rules are retained. The source uses Wisdom (Perception), which is not replaced by another edition's check.

指定施法距离内一个你能看见的自愿生物。直至法术终止前，目标速度翻倍；其AC获得+2加值；其进行敏捷豁免时具有优势；其每个回合都可作出一个额外的动作，但该动作只能用于执行攻击动作（仅一次攻击），或者疾走、撤离、躲藏和利用动作。
法术终止时，目标将泛起一阵倦意使其失能并且速度为0，持续至其下一回合结束。
target:
Choose a willing creature you can see within range. Until the spell ends, the target's Speed is doubled, it gains a +2 bonus to AC, it has Advantage on Dexterity saving throws, and it gains one additional action on each of its turns. That action can be used only to take the Attack action (one attack only), Dash, Disengage, Hide, or Utilize.
When the spell ends, a wave of lethargy leaves the target Incapacitated with a Speed of 0 until the end of its next turn.
note: Same-row N371 confirms Haste. The one-attack limit, Utilize action, and Incapacitated/Speed 0 ending effect follow this source in full.

source:
你打开了通往遥远国度的大门，展现其中难以名状的恐怖。以施法距离内一点为中心，一个半径 20 尺的黑暗球状区域显现并持续至该法术终止。这个球状区域是困难地形，并同时发散着能在30尺内听到的不谐耳语和啜嚼噪音。任何光照，无论是魔法光照还是其他光照都无法照亮这个区域，而完全进入该区域内的生物将陷入目盲状态。
任何在区域内开始其回合的生物将受到 2d6 点冷冻伤害。任何在区域内结束其回合的生物必须进行一次敏捷豁免，豁免失败者将因异界软体触手的触碰而受到2d6点强酸伤害。
升环施法：使用的法术位每比三环高一环，此法术造成的寒冷或者强酸伤害（由你选择）就增加1d6。
target:
You open a gateway to the Far Realm, revealing its indescribable horrors. A Sphere of darkness with a radius of 20 feet appears, centered on a point within range, and lasts until the spell ends. The Sphere is Difficult Terrain and emits discordant whispers and slurping noises audible within 30 feet. No light, magical or otherwise, can illuminate the area, and creatures fully inside it have the Blinded condition.
Any creature that starts its turn in the area takes 2d6 Cold damage. Any creature that ends its turn in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 2d6 Acid damage on a failed save from the touch of otherworldly, soft-bodied tentacles.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: Either the Cold or the Acid damage dealt by this spell, your choice, increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above third.
note: Same-row N372 confirms Hunger of Hadar. Start-of-turn Cold damage is automatic; only end-of-turn Acid damage calls for a save. Scaling increases one chosen damage type, not both.

source:
你在施法距离内一处边长 30 尺的立方区域内创造出一个在空中舞动旋转的彩色图纹。图纹在出现片刻后消失，然后迫使区域内每个看到它的生物进行一次感知豁免，豁免失败者将在法术持续时间内陷入魅惑状态。在被该法术魅惑期间，被该法术魅惑的生物陷入失能状态，且速度降为0。
如果受术生物受到任何伤害，或有其他生物用一个动作将其从恍惚中摇醒，则其身上的此效应将提前终止。
target:
You create a pattern of colors that dances and swirls in the air within a 30-foot Cube in range. The pattern appears for a moment and vanishes, forcing each creature in the area that sees it to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature has the Charmed condition for the duration. While Charmed by this spell, the creature is Incapacitated and its Speed is reduced to 0.
The effect ends early on an affected creature if it takes any damage or if another creature uses an action to shake it out of its stupor.
note: Same-row N373 confirms Hypnotic Pattern. Sight requirement, Charmed-dependent restrictions, and both early-ending conditions are retained.

source:
你释放出一个固定在原位的半径10尺的光环，光环会在法术持续时间内保持存在。如果光环的大小不足以完全覆盖其区域内的所有生物，法术会失败。
在施展此法术时即处于光环内的生物和物件可以自由进出光环。而所有其他生物和物件都将被阻挡而无法进出。三环或更低级别的法术既无法直接穿过光环施放，也无法使法术效果延伸至穿过光环。
光环内的空气干爽舒适，而无论外侧气候如何。你可以在法术终止前使光环内的光照变为昏暗光照或黑暗（无需任何动作）。光环从外侧看是不透明的，并且呈现出由你选定的颜色，但从内侧看它则是透明的。
当你离开该区域，或试图再次施展该法术时，法术将提前终止。
target:
You create an immobile Emanation with a radius of 10 feet that lasts for the duration. The spell fails if the Emanation isn't large enough to fully contain all creatures in its area.
Creatures and objects inside the Emanation when you cast this spell can move freely through it. All other creatures and objects are blocked from entering or leaving it. Spells of third level or lower can neither be cast through the Emanation nor extend their effects through it.
The air inside is dry and comfortable regardless of the weather outside. Before the spell ends, you can make the light inside the Emanation Dim Light or Darkness (no action required). The Emanation is opaque from outside and has a color of your choice, but it is transparent from inside.
The spell ends early if you leave the area or try to cast this spell again.
note: Same-row N374 confirms Leomund's Tiny Hut. The source's Emanation, fit-based failure, third-level-or-lower spell barrier, and recasting termination are retained; no remembered dome, occupant count, or different edition rule is substituted.

source:
当你的攻击命中一个目标或失手时，该武器的弹药或该武器本身变为一束闪电。作为目标从这次攻击中受到的任何伤害或其他效果的替代，若该攻击命中，则目标受到4d8点闪电伤害，若该攻击未命中，则受到一半伤害。无论你的攻击是否命中，目标周围10尺范围内的每个生物都必须进行一次敏捷豁免，豁免失败则受到2d8点闪电伤害，豁免成功则受到半数伤害。
在此之后，该弹药或武器变回其正常形态。
升环施法：使用的法术位每比三环高一环，上述两种效应的伤害都各增加1d8。
target:
When your attack hits a target or misses, the weapon's ammunition or the weapon itself becomes a bolt of lightning. In place of any damage or other effects the target would receive from that attack, the target takes 4d8 Lightning damage if the attack hits, or half as much damage if it misses. Whether the attack hits or misses, each creature within 10 feet of the target must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 2d8 Lightning damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
The ammunition or weapon then returns to its normal form.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: The damage of each of the two effects increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above third.
note: Same-row N375 spells the name Lightning Arrows. Both damage components and the replacement of the original attack's damage and other effects are preserved; scaling applies to both components.

source:
一束100 尺长，5尺宽的线状闪电从你的位置向你指定的方向爆发迸出。在线状区域内的每个生物必须进行一次敏捷豁免，豁免失败者将受到8d6点闪电伤害，豁免成功则受到一半伤害。
升环施法： 使用的法术位每比三环高一环，此法术的伤害就增加1d6。
target:
A bolt of lightning forming a Line 100 feet long and 5 feet wide bursts from you in a direction you choose. Each creature in the Line must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 8d6 Lightning damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above third.
note: Same-row N376 confirms Lightning Bolt. Line dimensions, save outcomes, and scaling are fully retained.

source:
指定施法距离内地面上你能看见的一点，并以该处为中心创造一个 10 尺半径、20 尺高的柱状魔法能量。承载能量柱的地面或其他平面上会显现出闪光的符文。
指定以下生物类型中的一种或多种：天族、元素、精类、邪魔、亡灵。法阵将会对被指定类型的生物产生以下效应：
　　• 该类生物不能以非魔法手段主动进入柱状区域内。如果该类生物试图使用传送或位面旅行进入此区域，则它必须先进行一次魅力豁免以判定其是否成功。
　　• 该类生物对柱状区域内的生物进行攻击检定时具有劣势。
　　• 柱状区域内的目标不受该类生物所魅惑、恐慌、或附身 。
施展该法术时，你可以选择让魔法作用于相反的方向来阻止特定种类的生物离开柱状区域内，以保护区域外的目标。
升环施法：使用的法术位每比三环高一环，法术持续时间就增加 1 小时。
target:
Choose a point on the ground you can see within range. A Cylinder of magical energy with a radius of 10 feet and a height of 20 feet appears centered there. Glowing runes appear on the ground or other surface supporting the Cylinder.
Choose one or more of these creature types: Celestial, Elemental, Fey, Fiend, or Undead. The circle affects creatures of the chosen types as follows:
    • Such a creature can't willingly enter the Cylinder by nonmagical means. If it tries to enter using teleportation or planar travel, it must first make a Charisma saving throw to determine whether it succeeds.
    • Such a creature has Disadvantage on attack rolls against creatures inside the Cylinder.
    • Targets inside the Cylinder can't be Charmed, Frightened, or possessed by such creatures.
When you cast this spell, you can reverse its direction, preventing creatures of the chosen types from leaving the Cylinder and protecting targets outside it.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: The duration increases by 1 hour for each spell slot level above third.
note: Same-row N377 confirms Magic Circle. All three bullets, five creature types, reversal option, and duration scaling are retained. The teleportation-save wording is translated as supplied rather than augmented.

你创造一个影像，其形象来自一个大小不超过边长20尺立方体的物件或生物，或是其他的可视现象。影像出现在施法距离内你能看见的一处位置并在法术持续时间内维持存在。它看起来完全是真实的，并且还具有相应的声音、气味和温度。但它无法造成伤害或让人陷入任何状态。
在该幻象施法距离内时，你可以用一个魔法动作将影像移动到施法距离内的另一个位置。影像改变位置时，你可以改变影像的外表来使它移动得更自然。例如，如果你创造了一个生物的影像并移动它，则你可以改变影像，使它看起来就像是在走路。或者你也可以让影像在不同的时间发出不同的声音，甚至可以让它参与一场对话。
由于影像可以被穿过，任何与该影像进行的物理互动都会暴露其幻象的本质。一个生物用研究动作调查影像时，它可以进行一次对抗你的法术豁免 DC 的智力（调查）检定，以判定是否看穿幻象。辨出幻象的生物可以看破该影像，而影像的其他感官效应在该生物看来会变得微弱而模糊。
升环施法： 使用高于三环的法术位时，法术时间持续至被解除且无需专注。
target:
You create an image of an object, a creature, or another visible phenomenon that fits within a 20-foot Cube. The image appears at a location you can see within range and lasts for the duration. It seems entirely real, including appropriate sounds, smells, and temperature, but it can't deal damage or impose any condition.
While you are within range of the illusion, you can take a Magic action to move the image to another location within range. As it moves, you can alter its appearance to make the movement seem natural. For example, if you create an image of a creature and move it, you can change the image so that it appears to walk. You can also make the image produce different sounds at different times, even allowing it to take part in a conversation.
Physical interaction with the image reveals its illusory nature, since things can pass through it. A creature that takes the Study action to examine the image can make an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC to discern the illusion. A creature that recognizes the illusion can see through the image, and its other sensory effects become faint and indistinct to that creature.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: If you use a spell slot above third level, the spell lasts until dispelled and doesn't require Concentration.
note: Same-row N378 confirms Major Image. Magic and Study actions and the source's above-third-level permanence threshold are retained, without substituting a different edition's slot threshold.

source:
你进入一个足以完全容纳你身体的石料物件或石料表面内，使你自己和你携带的所有装备在法术持续时间内与石料融为一体。你必须触碰该石料来做到这件事。此后，任何非魔法的感官都无法看到或侦测到你的存在。
与石料融合后，你看不到外界发生了什么，并且你为了聆听外界声音而进行的任何感知（察觉）检定都具有劣势。与石头融合时，你仍能感觉到时间的流逝，也可以对自己施展法术。你无法移动，但可以消耗5尺移动力从进入石头的地方离开石内，法术随之终止。
石头所受的轻微损伤不会对你造成伤害，不过石头部分损毁或者形状改变时（改变到不再适合容纳你的程度），会将你从石中排挤出并对你造成6d6点力场伤害。石头完全损毁（或材质改变）时，也会将你从石中排挤出并对你造成50点力场伤害。被排挤出石头时，你移动至距离第一次进入石头处最近的一处未被占据的空间位置，并陷入倒地状态。
target:
You enter a stone object or surface large enough to fully contain your body, merging yourself and all the equipment you carry with the stone for the duration. You must touch the stone to do so. Afterward, no nonmagical sense can see or detect your presence.
While merged with the stone, you can't see what happens outside, and you have Disadvantage on any Wisdom (Perception) check made to hear outside sounds. You remain aware of time passing and can cast spells on yourself. You can't move, but you can spend 5 feet of movement to leave the stone at the point where you entered, ending the spell.
Minor damage to the stone doesn't harm you. Partial destruction or a change in its shape that leaves it unable to contain you expels you and deals 6d6 Force damage to you. Complete destruction of the stone, or a change in its material, also expels you and deals 50 Force damage to you. When expelled, you move to the nearest unoccupied space to the point where you first entered the stone and have the Prone condition.
note: Same-row N380 confirms Meld Into Stone. The two distinct damage cases, movement cost, sensory limitations, and exit location are complete.

source:
一匹拟真的大型马形生物出现在施法距离内你选择的一处地面上的未占据空间中。你决定该生物的样貌，且它装备着鞍座、嚼子和缰绳。这些随法术创造的装备一旦离开坐骑10尺即化作一阵烟消失不见。
在法术持续时间内，你或者一名你指定的生物可以骑乘此坐骑。坐骑使用乘用马Riding Horse的数据（见附录B），不过其具有100尺速度，每小时可行进13里。法术终止时，坐骑会慢慢消失，骑手有1分钟的时间下马。坐骑受到伤害时，法术将提前终止。
target:
A lifelike Large horse-shaped creature appears in an unoccupied space on the ground of your choice within range. You determine its appearance, and it is equipped with a saddle, bit, and bridle. Equipment created with the spell vanishes in a puff of smoke if moved 10 feet away from the mount.
For the duration, you or a creature you designate can ride the mount. It uses the Riding Horse stat block (see appendix B), except that its Speed is 100 feet and it can travel 13 li per hour. When the spell ends, the mount gradually fades away, giving its rider 1 minute to dismount. The spell ends early if the mount takes damage.
note: Same-row N382 confirms Phantom Steed. The source uses bare li for travel distance; it is retained as li rather than silently converted to miles. The appendix reference and all equipment/dismount details remain. Independent review adopted by root: retain the stated 10-foot separation without adding a strict greater-than condition.

source:
该法术将活力引导给特定区域中的植物。本法术的施法时间取决于你选择下述效应之一：繁茂或丰产。
　　• 繁茂Overgrowth。 你指定施法距离内一点，以该点为中心100尺半径的球状范围内的普通植物将变的粗壮繁茂。一名穿过该区域的生物每移动1尺必须花费4尺移动力。你可以在该法术范围内空出一块或多块任意大小的区域，将其排除在法术效应影响之外。
　　• 丰产Enrichment。 你指定施法距离内一点，距该点半里内的植物的产量将在365日内被强化。这些植物收获时将产出两倍于正常产量的作物。这些植物每年仅能从一道植物滋长中获益。
target:
This spell channels vitality into plants in a particular area. Its casting time depends on which of the following effects you choose: Overgrowth or Enrichment.
    • Overgrowth. Choose a point within range. Normal plants within a Sphere with a radius of 100 feet centered on that point become thick and overgrown. A creature moving through the area must spend 4 feet of movement for every 1 foot it moves. You can exclude one or more areas of any size within the spell's area from its effect.
    • Enrichment. Choose a point within range. Plants within half a li of that point have their yields enhanced for 365 days. When harvested, they produce twice the normal amount of food. These plants can benefit from only one Plant Growth spell per year.
note: Same-row N383 confirms Plant Growth. Both modes and their exclusions/annual limit are complete. Bare li is retained, not converted to miles; the written half remains written as half.

source:
你向你所遇到过的或某人遇到过且向你描述的一个生物发送一小段二十五个词以内的信息。该生物将在心中听到你的信息，它可以认出你是发讯人（如果他认识你），还可以用同样的方式立即回复一条讯息。法术会让目标能够理解你短讯的信息。
你的传讯可以跨越任意长的距离，甚至能跨越位面。但如果目标和你不在同一个存在位面，则短讯术有5%的概率无法到达。如果讯息没能传达，你将得知这一结果。
在收到你的信息后，一个生物能够屏蔽你以这个法术再次对他发信的能力，持续8小时。如果你在这段时间内试图送出另一条信息，你会得知你的短讯被屏蔽，并且法术失败。
target:
You send a short message of no more than twenty-five words to a creature you have met, or to one someone else has met and described to you. The creature hears the message in its mind, recognizes you as the sender if it knows you, and can immediately send a reply in the same way. The spell enables the target to understand your message.
You can send the message across any distance, even to another plane. If the target is on a different plane of existence, however, there is a 5% chance the message doesn't arrive. You learn if it fails to arrive.
After receiving your message, a creature can block you from sending it further messages with this spell for 8 hours. If you try to send another message during that time, you learn that your message has been blocked, and the spell fails.
note: Same-row N387 confirms Sending. Described recipients, failure notification, and recipient blocking are preserved; twenty-five is written out to match the source's written number.

source:
你指定施法距离内一点，并使以该点为中心，高40尺、半径20尺的柱状区域内降下冷冻刺骨的冻雨和冰雹直至法术终止。该区域将造成重度遮蔽，且该区域内的一切外露的暴露在外的明火都将被浇熄。
该区域的地面变成困难地形。生物在一个回合内首次进入该区域或在区域内开始其回合时，它必须成功通过一次敏捷豁免，否则将陷入倒地状态并失去专注。
target:
Choose a point within range. Freezing rain and sleet fall in a Cylinder centered on that point, 40 feet high with a radius of 20 feet, until the spell ends. The area is Heavily Obscured, and all exposed open flames in it are extinguished.
The ground in the area becomes Difficult Terrain. When a creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or have the Prone condition and lose Concentration.
note: Same-row N388 confirms Sleet Storm. Height 40/radius 20 follow this source exactly. Prone and loss of Concentration both occur on a failed Dexterity save.

source:
你在施法距离内一处 40 尺立方区域内指定至多六个生物并扭曲其周围的时间流。每个目标都要进行一次感知豁免，豁免失败则受到该法术影响直至法术终止。
被影响的生物的速度减半，而其 AC 和敏捷豁免都获得-2减值，且不能执行反应。该生物在其回合内可以执行一个动作或一个附赠动作，但不能在一回合内同时执行以上两者。当它执行攻击动作时，它只能发动一次攻击。
如果该生物尝试施展一个具有姿势成分的法术，则其法术有25%的概率会因为生物的动作太慢而施展失败。
受术生物在其每个回合结束时可以再进行一次该感知豁免，豁免成功则终止其身上的该法术效应。
target:
You alter the flow of time around up to six creatures of your choice in a 40-foot Cube within range. Each target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it is affected by the spell until the spell ends.
An affected creature's Speed is halved, it takes a -2 penalty to AC and Dexterity saving throws, and it can't take Reactions. On its turn, it can take an action or a Bonus Action, but not both. When it takes the Attack action, it can make only one attack.
If the creature attempts to cast a spell with a Somatic component, there is a 25% chance the spell fails because the creature's movements are too slow.
An affected creature can repeat the Wisdom saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell's effect on itself on a success.
note: Same-row N389 confirms Slow. This source uses a Somatic-component failure chance; no alternative casting-delay mechanic is substituted. All action limits and the repeat save remain.

source:
你给施法距离内一具你所选择的尸体施以复生的表象，让其可回答你的问题。这具尸体必须还有一张嘴，且如果该生物死亡时是亡灵生物，则施法失败。若目标尸体在最近十日内曾被作为该法术的目标，则本次施法失败。
在法术终止前，你可以向尸体提出最多五个问题。尸体的知识和它讲述的语言仅限于其生前所知。回答通常是简短，含糊或重复的语句，而且如果你对尸体抱有敌意或者尸体认为你是其敌人，它也不是一定要给你正确的答复。该法术并不能让该生物的灵魂返回其身体中，只是活化了其精神。因此，该尸体不能认知新的信息，不能理解它死后发生的任何事情，也不能对未来的事件作出猜测。
target:
You give a corpse of your choice within range a semblance of life, allowing it to answer your questions. The corpse must still have a mouth, and the spell fails if the creature was Undead when it died. The spell also fails if the corpse has been a target of this spell within the last ten days.
Before the spell ends, you can ask the corpse up to five questions. It knows only what it knew in life and speaks only the languages it knew then. Answers are usually brief, cryptic, or repetitive, and the corpse isn't compelled to answer truthfully if you are hostile toward it or it regards you as an enemy. This spell doesn't return the creature's soul to its body; it only animates its spirit. Consequently, the corpse can't learn new information, understand anything that happened after its death, or speculate about future events.
note: Same-row N390 confirms Speak with Dead. Both failure conditions, five-question limit, hostility direction, and all limits on knowledge are retained.

source:
你给周围30尺固定灵光范围内的植物赋予有限的知觉与活力，使其能够与你沟通和按你的简单命令行事。你可以向植物询问最近一日该法术区域内所发生的事，由此了解有关于曾路过这里的生物、天气和其他状况的信息。
你可以让区域内因植物生长形成的困难地形（如灌木丛）在法术持续时间内变为普通地形。你也可以在法术持续时间内将有植物生长的普通地形变成困难地形。
虽然该法术并不能让植物拔根而起或移动位置，但它们可以依你的意愿而活动自己的树枝、藤蔓和茎秆。
如果法术区域内有一个植物生物，你可以如同有共同语言一般与其交流。
target:
You give plants in an immobile 30-foot Emanation around you limited awareness and animation, enabling them to communicate with you and follow simple commands. You can ask the plants about events in the spell's area within the last day, learning about creatures that passed through, the weather, and other circumstances.
For the duration, you can turn Difficult Terrain caused by plant growth in the area, such as thickets, into ordinary terrain. You can also turn ordinary terrain containing plants into Difficult Terrain for the duration.
The spell doesn't let plants uproot themselves or move from place to place, but they can move their branches, tendrils, and stalks as you wish.
If a Plant creature is in the spell's area, you can communicate with it as though you shared a language.
note: Same-row N391 confirms Speak with Plants. The source explicitly describes the Emanation as fixed; that qualification and both terrain directions are preserved.

source:
在法术持续时间内，保护性的灵体环绕在你的周围15尺灵光范围内飞舞。如果你属于善良或中立阵营，则它们飘渺的身形看起来像是天使或精类生物（由你选择）。如果你属于邪恶阵营，则它们将形如邪魔。
施展此法术时，你可以指定特定生物让其不受该法术影响。除此之外的生物在灵光区域内将受法术影响致速度被减半。当灵光进入一个生物的空间、一个生物进入灵光或在灵光内结束回合时，，其必须进行一次感知豁免。豁免失败将受到3d8点光耀伤害（如果你属于善良或中立）或3d8点黯蚀伤害（如果你属于邪恶），豁免成功则只受到一半伤害。一名生物一回合仅需进行一次该豁免。
升环施法： 使用的法术位每比三环高一环，此法术的伤害就增加 1d8。
target:
Protective spirits flit around you in a 15-foot Emanation for the duration. If you are Good or Neutral, their spectral forms resemble angels or Fey, your choice. If you are Evil, they resemble Fiends.
When you cast this spell, you can designate creatures to be unaffected by it. Other creatures have their Speed halved while in the Emanation. When the Emanation enters a creature's space, a creature enters the Emanation, or a creature ends its turn there, it must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 3d8 Radiant damage if you are Good or Neutral, or 3d8 Necrotic damage if you are Evil. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage. A creature makes this save only once per turn.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above third.
note: Same-row N392 confirms Spirit Guardians. All three trigger events and the once-per-turn save limit follow the supplied version; no start-of-turn trigger is substituted.

source:
你以施法距离内一点为中心创造出一团半径 20 尺的黄色恶心气体云团球状区域。云团内形成重度遮蔽。云团会一直留在空中，直至法术持续时间结束或一阵强风（比如造风术Gust of Wind创造的强风）将其吹散为止。
如果一个生物在其回合开始时位于云团内，则它必须成功通过一次体质豁免。否则将陷入中毒状态直到其当前回合结束。因此而陷入中毒状态期间，该生物无法执行动作或附赠动作。
target:
You create a Sphere of nauseating yellow gas with a radius of 20 feet, centered on a point within range. The cloud's area is Heavily Obscured. The cloud lingers in the air until the duration ends or a strong wind, such as one created by Gust of Wind, disperses it.
A creature that starts its turn in the cloud must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or have the Poisoned condition until the end of its current turn. While Poisoned in this way, the creature can't take actions or Bonus Actions.
note: Same-row N393 confirms Stinking Cloud. The Poisoned-dependent action restriction and strong-wind dispersal are retained without adding breathing or immunity exceptions absent from the source.

source:
你唤来一个妖精灵魄。其使用下文妖精灵魄的数据，并会在施法距离内一处你可见的未被占据的空间中显现。当你施展法术时，从愤怒、欢欣、诡诈中选择一种情绪，该生物会显现为一个受你所选情绪所影响的妖精生物，其数据中的部分特性也受此影响。该生物会在生命值降为0或是法术结束时消失。
该生物是你的盟友（对你的其它盟友亦是如此）。它在战斗中使用你的先攻，并在你回合结束后立即行动。它遵从于你的口头指令（无需任何动作）。如果你不发令，它将执行回避动作并远离危险。
升环施法：该生物的数据使用新的法术环阶。

妖精灵魄Fey Spirit 
小型妖精，绝对中立
AC 12+法术环阶
HP 30+每比3环高的法术环阶10点
速度30尺，飞行30尺
力量13|+1|+1 敏捷16|+3|+3 体质14|+2|+2
智力14|+2|+2 感知11|+0|+0 魅力16|+3|+3
免疫：魅惑
感官：黑暗视觉60尺，被动察觉10
语言：木族语，理解你的语言
CR无（XP0；PB等于你的熟练加值）
动作Actions
多重攻击Multiattack。灵魄发动等于法术环阶一半次数的妖精之剑攻击（向下取整）。
妖精之剑Fey Blade。近战攻击检定：加值等于你的法术攻击加值，触及5尺。命中：2d6+3+法术环阶的力场伤害。
附赠动作Bonus Actions 
妖精步伐Fey Step。灵魄魔法地传送至多30尺至一处它可见的未被占据空间。随后根据所选情绪，灵魄触发以下效果之一：

愤怒Fuming。妖精在此回合结束前的下一次攻击检定具有优势。
欢欣Mirthful。感知豁免：DC等于你的法术豁免DC，单一灵魄10尺内它可见的生物。失败：目标受你和灵魄魅惑1分钟或直到目标受到任意伤害。
诡诈Tricksy。灵魄令魔法黑暗充斥于它5尺内的一处10尺立方区域，持续直到灵魄的下一回合结束。
target:
You call forth a Fey spirit. It uses the Fey Spirit stat block below and appears in an unoccupied space you can see within range. When you cast the spell, choose an emotion: Fuming, Mirthful, or Tricksy. The creature appears as a Fey influenced by your chosen emotion, which also determines some traits in its stat block. The creature disappears when its Hit Points drop to 0 or the spell ends.
The creature is your ally and an ally of your other allies. In combat, it shares your Initiative and takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your verbal commands, which require no action. If you give no command, it takes the Dodge action and moves away from danger.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: Use the new spell level in the creature's stat block.

Fey Spirit
Small Fey, Neutral
AC 12 + the spell's level
HP 30 + 10 for each spell level above 3
Speed 30 feet, Fly 30 feet
STR 13 | +1 | +1; DEX 16 | +3 | +3; CON 14 | +2 | +2
INT 14 | +2 | +2; WIS 11 | +0 | +0; CHA 16 | +3 | +3
Immunities: Charmed
Senses: Darkvision 60 feet, Passive Perception 10
Languages: Sylvan; understands your languages
CR None (XP 0; PB equals your Proficiency Bonus)
Actions
Multiattack. The spirit makes a number of Fey Blade attacks equal to half the spell's level, rounded down.
Fey Blade. Melee Attack Roll: Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 5 feet. Hit: 2d6 + 3 + the spell's level Force damage.
Bonus Actions
Fey Step. The spirit magically teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. It then produces one of the following effects, based on the chosen emotion:

Fuming. The Fey has Advantage on its next attack roll before the end of this turn.
Mirthful. Wisdom Saving Throw: DC equals your spell save DC, one creature the spirit can see within 10 feet of itself. Failure: The target is Charmed by you and the spirit for 1 minute or until the target takes any damage.
Tricksy. The spirit fills a 10-foot Cube within 5 feet of itself with magical Darkness until the end of its next turn.
note: Same-row N394 confirms Summon Fey. The complete stat block, all ability triplets in source order, Fly speed, three emotion branches, and their exact timings are retained. The source does not print headings for the triplet columns; none are invented.

source:
你唤来一个亡灵灵魄。其使用下文亡灵灵魄的数据，并会在施法距离内一处你可见的未被占据的空间中显现。当你施展法术时，从幽体，腐尸，骷髅中选择一类，该生物会显现为你所选的那类形态的亡灵生物，其数据中的部分特性也受此影响。该生物会在生命值降为0或是法术结束时消失。
该生物是你的盟友（对你的其它盟友亦是如此）。它在战斗中使用你的先攻，并在你回合结束后立即行动。它遵从于你的口头指令（无需任何动作）。如果你不发令，它将执行回避动作并远离危险。
升环施法：该生物的数据使用新的法术环阶。

亡灵灵魄Undead Spirit
中型亡灵，绝对中立
AC 11+法术环阶
HP 30（仅幽体和腐尸）或20（仅骷髅）+每比3环高的法术环阶10点
速度30尺；飞行40尺（悬浮；仅幽体）
力量12|+1|+1 敏捷16|+3|+3 体质15|+2|+2
智力4|-3|-3 感知10|+0|+0 魅力9|-1|-1
免疫：暗蚀，毒素；力竭，恐慌，麻痹，中毒
感官：黑暗视觉60尺，被动察觉10
语言：理解你说的语言
CR无（XP0；PB等于你的熟练加值）
特质Traits
腐灭灵光Festering Aura（仅腐尸）。体质豁免：DC等于你的法术豁免DC，所有在以灵魄为源点5尺光环区域内开始其回合的生物（除了你）。失败：该生物陷入中毒状态，直至其下一回合开始。
虚体移动Incorporeal Movement（仅幽体）。灵魄可以虚体化并如同穿过困难地形一样穿过其他生物和物件。如果它在自己的回合结束时仍处在物件内部，则被挪到距离最近的未被占据的位置，且每因此移动5尺便受到1d10力场伤害。
动作Actions
多重攻击Multiattack。灵魄发动等于法术环阶一半次数的攻击（向下取整）。
致死之触Deathly Touch（仅幽体）。近战攻击检定：加值等于你的法术攻击加值，触及5尺。命中：1d8+3+法术环阶的暗蚀伤害，且目标陷入恐慌状态直至其下一回合结束。
暗澹箭Grave Bolt（仅骷髅）。远程攻击检定：加值等于你的法术攻击加值，射程150尺。命中：2d4+3+法术环阶的暗蚀伤害。
腐灭爪击Rotting Claw（仅腐尸）。近战攻击检定：加值等于你的法术攻击加值，触及5尺。命中：1d6+3+法术环阶的挥砍伤害。若目标具有中毒状态，则其还会陷入麻痹状态，直至其下一回合结束。
target:
You call forth an Undead spirit. It uses the Undead Spirit stat block below and appears in an unoccupied space you can see within range. When you cast the spell, choose Ghostly, Putrid, or Skeletal. The creature appears as an Undead of the chosen form, which also determines some traits in its stat block. The creature disappears when its Hit Points drop to 0 or the spell ends.
The creature is your ally and an ally of your other allies. In combat, it shares your Initiative and takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your verbal commands, which require no action. If you give no command, it takes the Dodge action and moves away from danger.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: Use the new spell level in the creature's stat block.

Undead Spirit
Medium Undead, Neutral
AC 11 + the spell's level
HP 30 (Ghostly and Putrid only) or 20 (Skeletal only) + 10 for each spell level above 3
Speed 30 feet; Fly 40 feet (Hover; Ghostly only)
STR 12 | +1 | +1; DEX 16 | +3 | +3; CON 15 | +2 | +2
INT 4 | -3 | -3; WIS 10 | +0 | +0; CHA 9 | -1 | -1
Immunities: Necrotic, Poison; Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned
Senses: Darkvision 60 feet, Passive Perception 10
Languages: Understands the languages you speak
CR None (XP 0; PB equals your Proficiency Bonus)
Traits
Festering Aura (Putrid Only). Constitution Saving Throw: DC equals your spell save DC, all creatures except you that start their turns in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the spirit. Failure: The creature is Poisoned until the start of its next turn.
Incorporeal Movement (Ghostly Only). The spirit can become incorporeal and move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. If it ends its turn inside an object, it is moved to the nearest unoccupied space, taking 1d10 Force damage for every 5 feet moved this way.
Actions
Multiattack. The spirit makes a number of attacks equal to half the spell's level, rounded down.
Deathly Touch (Ghostly Only). Melee Attack Roll: Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 5 feet. Hit: 1d8 + 3 + the spell's level Necrotic damage, and the target is Frightened until the end of its next turn.
Grave Bolt (Skeletal Only). Ranged Attack Roll: Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, range 150 feet. Hit: 2d4 + 3 + the spell's level Necrotic damage.
Rotting Claw (Putrid Only). Melee Attack Roll: Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 5 feet. Hit: 1d6 + 3 + the spell's level Slashing damage. If the target is Poisoned, it is also Paralyzed until the end of its next turn.
note: Same-row N395 confirms Summon Undead. The entire stat block, every ability triplet, form restriction, immunity, and three attacks are retained. The HP expression keeps the source's placement of the shared-looking increment rather than silently changing its grouping.

source:
你的阴影环绕着的手可以吸取他人的生命力来为自己疗伤。对你触及范围内的一名生物进行一次近战法术攻击。若命中，则目标受到3d6点暗蚀伤害，而你则恢复数值等同于所造成暗蚀伤害一半的生命值。
该法术终止前，你可以在你的每个回合内用魔法动作对相同或不同的生物进行一次这样的攻击。
升环施法：使用的法术位每比三环高一环，此法术的伤害就提高1d6。
target:
Your shadow-wreathed hand can drain another creature's life force to heal you. Make a melee spell attack against a creature within your reach. On a hit, the target takes 3d6 Necrotic damage, and you regain Hit Points equal to half the Necrotic damage dealt.
Until the spell ends, you can take a Magic action on each of your turns to make this attack against the same creature or a different one.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above third.
note: Same-row N397 confirms Vampiric Touch. Healing is based on Necrotic damage actually dealt; repeated attacks use the source's Magic action.

source:
此法术赋予你选择的位于施法距离内的至多十名生物在持续时间内将任何液体表面（比如水、酸、泥、雪、流沙、岩浆等）视作无害的固体地面穿越的能力（穿越熔岩的生物仍然会因炽热受到伤害）。
一名受影响的目标必须用一个附赠动作才能穿过液体表面进入其内部，反之亦然。然而若目标将因坠落而进入液体中，则其会直接穿过液体表面，如常进入其内部。
target:
For the duration, this spell allows up to ten creatures of your choice within range to cross any liquid surface, such as water, acid, mud, snow, quicksand, or lava, as though it were harmless solid ground. Creatures crossing lava still take damage from its heat.
An affected target must use a Bonus Action to pass through a liquid's surface into the liquid, or vice versa. If a target falls into the liquid, however, it passes through the surface and enters the liquid normally.
note: Same-row N399 confirms Water Walk. All listed surfaces, the lava exception, both surface-crossing directions, and the falling exception are retained.

source:

target:

target:

• 你唤来一个暗影灵魄。其在施法距离内你可见的一个未占据位置化为实体。这一实体使用下面的暗影灵魄Shadow Spirit的数据。当你施展法术时，当你施展法术时，从暴怒Fury，绝望Despair或恐惧Fear中选择一种情感。此生物的外形为一个受你所选情感所影响的畸形二足生物，其资料表中的部分特性也受此影响。当其生命值降到0或法术结束时，生物消失。

The cursed creature spitefully tries to spread the disease to its enemies. On each turn, if space to move is available, it must Dash toward its nearest enemy by the safest route. When it comes within 5 feet of any enemy, it makes an Unarmed Strike against that enemy.
note: Same-row N423 confirms Curse of the Putrid Husk. Both alternative behaviors, safest-route requirements, and different triggers are retained. The supplied body states no saving throw; none is invented.

source: 你低语着迫近死亡的预言，这些话语渗入某个生物的命运丝线，将其引向死亡的时刻。一个在你施法距离内你可见的生物必须进行一次魅力豁免。豁免失败，则当该生物受到来自一次攻击的伤害时，你可以执行反应动作发动效果：无需掷伤害骰，而是直接使用每个伤害骰所能掷出的最大值。目标在每个其回合结束时重复豁免，豁免成功则法术终止。
target: You whisper a prophecy of approaching death, weaving the words into a creature's fate to draw it toward its demise. A creature you can see within range must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, whenever the creature takes damage from an attack, you can use your Reaction to cause the damage dice to use their maximum possible values instead of being rolled. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on a success.
note: Same-row N424 confirms Doom. The Reaction trigger is taking damage from an attack, as supplied; the apparent timing of replacing a damage roll is not redesigned.

source:
你咒唤一只幽灵黑豹，令其扑杀施法距离内你可见的生物，撕咬并压制其以便你近处的盟友将其击杀。
目标进行一次力量豁免。豁免失败则受到8d6力场伤害并陷入束缚状态直至法术结束。豁免成功则仅受半伤然后法术结束。束缚期间，目标的回合开始时，其受到2d6力场伤害。目标或其触及范围内的生物能够以动作进行力量（运动）检定对抗你的法术豁免DC，成功则法术结束。
升环施法。使用四环或更高法术位施展该法术时，你使用的法术位每比三环高一环，伤害就增加1d6。
context: column:M;spell:Phantom Panther;book:火炬光下的克苏鲁;level:3
target:
You conjure a spectral black panther to pounce on a creature you can see within range, biting and pinning it so your nearby allies can kill it.
The target makes a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 8d6 Force damage and is Restrained until the spell ends. On a successful save, it takes only half as much damage, and the spell ends. While Restrained, the target takes 2d6 Force damage at the start of its turn. The target, or a creature within reach of it, can use an action to make a Strength (Athletics) check against your spell save DC, ending the spell on a success.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of fourth level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above third.
note: Same-row N425 confirms Phantom Panther. Both initial outcomes, ongoing damage, and assistance with escape remain. The source says damage increases without specifying which damage component; that ambiguity is retained.

source:
一个半径20尺的阴郁球状区域从施法距离内你所选的一点迸发，来自阴影维度的邪恶能量席卷整片区域。你选择一个实体，将其短暂推入现实，带来惊骇一瞬。当你施展此法术时，选择下列选项之一：
恐惧匿于黑暗The Darkness Hides Terrors。 区域内所有你选择的生物都必须进行一次敏捷豁免。豁免失败则受到4d8心灵伤害，并且必须使用其反应沿最安全的路线，尽可能远离你所选的那个点。豁免成功则仅受一半伤害。
暗影之墓Tomb of Shadows。 区域内所有你选择的生物都必须进行一次体质豁免。豁免失败则受到4d8暗蚀伤害，并且其速度减少20尺。豁免成功则仅受一半伤害。
升环施法。使用的法术位每比三环高一环，伤害便增加1d8。
context: column:M;spell:Shadowy Eruption;book:火炬光下的克苏鲁;level:3
target:
A gloomy Sphere with a radius of 20 feet erupts from a point you choose within range, sweeping the area with sinister energy from a dimension of shadow. You choose an entity to briefly force into reality, creating a moment of terror. When you cast this spell, choose one of these options:
The Darkness Hides Terrors. Each creature you choose in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 4d8 Psychic damage and must use its Reaction to move as far as possible from the chosen point by the safest route. On a successful save, it takes only half as much damage.
Tomb of Shadows. Each creature you choose in the area must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 4d8 Necrotic damage and its Speed is reduced by 20 feet. On a successful save, it takes only half as much damage.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above third.
note: Same-row N426 confirms Shadowy Eruption. Both named modes retain their separate saves and damage types. The source doesn't specify a duration for Tomb of Shadows' Speed reduction; none is added.

source: 你已掌握维瑞之印，这是一个据说在创世前就已存在的古代符文。选择施法距离内你可见的一个生物。当你使用法术正常对该生物造成伤害并投掷一枚或多枚骰子时，不对此次伤害进行掷骰，取而代之，你直接取每个骰子的最大面值。此外，你可以选择一个你能施放的五环或更低环阶且施法时间为动作的法术。你可以将其作为施放维瑞之印的一部分进行施放，并同时消耗两个法术的法术位。
context: column:M;spell:Voorish Sign;book:火炬光下的克苏鲁;level:3
target: You have mastered the Voorish Sign, an ancient rune said to predate creation. Choose a creature you can see within range. When you would normally roll one or more dice to deal damage to that creature with a spell, don't roll that damage; instead, use the maximum value of each die. In addition, you can choose a spell you can cast of fifth level or lower with a casting time of an action. You can cast it as part of casting Voorish Sign, expending the spell slots for both spells.
note: Same-row N427 confirms Voorish Sign. The damage maximization is for spell damage to the chosen creature; the optional second spell retains its level/casting-time limits and both-slot cost.

source:
一团辛辣刺鼻的化学物质从你的手中喷涌而出。30尺锥形范围内的所有生物必须进行一次敏捷豁免。豁免失败则受到10d4点强酸伤害，豁免成功则伤害减半。
这股强酸会破坏法术范围内任何有机物制成的物件。一个被此法术杀死的生物肉体会完全溶解，只留下一具腐烂的骨架。
升环施法效应：使用四环或更高法术位施展该法术时，你使用的法术位每比三环高一环，强酸伤害就增加2d4点。
target:
A pungent burst of chemicals sprays from your hands. Every creature in a 30-foot Cone must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 10d4 Acid damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
The acid destroys any object made of organic material in the spell's area. A creature killed by the spell has its flesh completely dissolved, leaving only a decaying skeleton.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of fourth level or higher, the Acid damage increases by 2d4 for each slot level above third.
note: Same-row N428 confirms Corrosive Blast. The source's unrestricted organic-object destruction and slain-creature effect remain; no worn/carried exception is added.

source:
你在接触的一件武器上抹上一层酸性物质。直到法术结束前，这把武器一旦命中将额外造成2d4点强酸伤害。如果这把武器还不是魔法武器，那么在法术持续时间内它变为魔法武器。
除此之外，被这把武器以近战攻击命中的生物必须进行一次体质豁免。若豁免失败，则该生物陷入中毒状态，直到攻击者的下个回合结束。
升环施法效应：使用四环或更高法术位施展该法术时，你使用的法术位每比三环高一环，强酸伤害就增加1d4点。
target:
You coat a weapon you touch with an acidic substance. Until the spell ends, the weapon deals an extra 2d4 Acid damage whenever it hits. If it isn't already a magic weapon, it becomes one for the duration.
In addition, a creature hit by a melee attack with the weapon must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is Poisoned until the end of the attacker's next turn.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of fourth level or higher, the Acid damage increases by 1d4 for each slot level above third.
note: Same-row N429 confirms Fetid Blade. Extra damage applies on a hit; only the Poisoned rider specifically requires a melee attack. Its ending uses the attacker's next turn, not automatically the caster's.

source:
你用一种魔法疾病感染范围内你能看到的至多三个生物。在目标的每个回合开始时，它必须通过一次体质豁免。若豁免失败，该生物需要承受3d6点黯蚀伤害并积累一层力竭。如果一个目标累计成功通过了三次豁免，则法术在该生物身上终止。
法术次级复原术Lesser Restoration可以提前结束目标身上的此法术。
target:
You infect up to three creatures you can see within range with a magical disease. At the start of each of its turns, a target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 3d6 Necrotic damage and gains one level of Exhaustion. Once a target has succeeded on a total of three saves, the spell ends on that creature.
Lesser Restoration can end this spell on a target early.
note: Same-row N430 confirms Pestilence. Successes are cumulative, not necessarily consecutive, and the source's disease-removal spell is retained.

source:
范围内你选择的一个生物必须通过一次体质豁免，否则将承受8d6点毒素伤害并陷入中毒状态，直到你的下个回合结束。当以此法术的效果陷入中毒状态时，目标同时会陷入震慑状态。若豁免检定成功，目标受到一半伤害且不会陷入中毒状态。
升环施法效应：使用四环或更高法术位施展该法术时，你使用的法术位每比三环高一环，毒素伤害就增加1d6点。
target:
A creature you choose within range must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 8d6 Poison damage and is Poisoned until the end of your next turn. While Poisoned by this spell, the target is also Stunned. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and isn't Poisoned.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of fourth level or higher, the Poison damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above third.
note: Same-row N431 confirms Tranquilizing Toxin. Stunned is conditional on being Poisoned by this spell; it is not an independent successful-save rider.

source:
你以施法距离内一点为源点，召唤一道半径15尺、高10尺的柱状海水洪流。洪流会呈现为浪涛、漩涡、水龙卷、或其他由你选择的形态。柱状区域内的每个生物必须成功通过一次力量豁免，否则将受到2d8钝击伤害并倒地。你可以选择至多等同于你施法属性调整值（至少可以选择一个）的生物对抗本法术的豁免自动成功。
如果你处于本法术范围内，作为你施展此法术的动作的一部分，你可以消失在洪流中并传送到法术范围内的一个未被占据的空内间。
context: column:M;spell:Freedom of the Wave;book:塔尔多雷战役设定集：重制版;level:3
target:
You conjure a surge of seawater in a Cylinder with a radius of 15 feet and a height of 10 feet, originating from a point within range. The surge can look like waves, a whirlpool, a waterspout, or another form you choose. Each creature in the Cylinder must succeed on a Strength saving throw or take 2d8 Bludgeoning damage and fall Prone. You can choose a number of creatures up to your spellcasting ability modifier, with a minimum of one, to automatically succeed on their saves against this spell.
If you are in the spell's area, as part of the action used to cast it, you can disappear into the surge and teleport to an unoccupied space in the spell's area.
note: Same-row N433 confirms Freedom of the Wave. Automatic-save exemptions, minimum one, and the caster's conditional teleport remain. The source supplies no successful-save damage, so none is added.

source:
你在空中召唤出一颗加农炮弹，以全速飞出，并在碰撞后爆炸。对法术施法距离内的一个你可见的目标发动一次远程法术攻击。命中时，目标受到5d10钝击伤害，而且炮弹将爆炸。爆炸将覆盖以其为源头的5尺光环区域，区域内除目标外的所有生物都需要进行一次敏捷豁免，豁免失败者将受到上述伤害的一半。
升环施法。使用的法术位每比三环高1环，炮弹的伤害就增加1d10。
context: column:M;spell:Conjure Cannonball;book:瓦尔达的秘密尖塔;level:3
target:
You conjure a cannonball in the air that flies at full speed and explodes on impact. Make a ranged spell attack against a target you can see within range. On a hit, the target takes 5d10 Bludgeoning damage and the cannonball explodes. The explosion fills a 5-foot Emanation originating from the cannonball. Every creature in that area except the target must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking half the above damage on a failed save.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: The cannonball's damage increases by 1d10 for every 1 spell slot level above third.
note: Same-row N434 confirms Conjure Cannonball. The source specifies an on-hit explosion, excludes the attack's target from its save, and gives only failed-save splash damage. No miss explosion or successful-save damage is invented; the explicit numeric 1 in scaling is retained.

source: 你触摸的一生物身上出现两条由绚丽奥术能量组成的肌肉手臂。这些手臂功能完备，可以用来握住武器和盾牌（允许目标持握2件双手武器或4 件单手武器），执行法术的姿势成分，以及执行其他动作。在法术持续时间内，目标在力量（运动）检定中具有优势。目标可以使用一个附赠动作，使用这些手臂持握的一把武器进行一次近战攻击。
target: Two muscular arms made of brilliant arcane energy appear on a creature you touch. The arms are fully functional and can hold weapons and shields, allowing the target to hold 2 two-handed weapons or 4 one-handed weapons, perform Somatic spell components, and carry out other actions. For the duration, the target has Advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks. It can use a Bonus Action to make one melee attack with a weapon held in these arms.
note: Same-row N435 confirms Polybrachia. Extra arms, both explicit weapon counts, Somatic use, Athletics Advantage, and one Bonus Action attack remain without adding extra actions.

source:
你在施法距离内一个你选择的点创造出一团由蝴蝶组成的混乱云团，形成一个20尺半径的球形区域。该区域被重度遮蔽，区域内原有的烟雾会被驱散。
当你施展此法术时，你可以选择区域内的一些生物无视以下效应。在法术持续时间内，受影响区域变为困难地形。当生物试图离开法术区域时，它必须进行一次力量豁免。豁免失败时，该生物会被拉回到球体中心最近的未被占据空间。
target:
You create a chaotic cloud of butterflies in a Sphere with a radius of 20 feet, centered on a point you choose within range. The area is Heavily Obscured, and any smoke already there is dispersed.
When you cast the spell, you can choose creatures in the area to ignore the following effects. For the duration, the affected area becomes Difficult Terrain. When a creature tries to leave the spell's area, it must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, it is pulled into the unoccupied space nearest the Sphere's center.
note: Same-row N436 confirms Butterfly Storm. Chosen exemptions apply to the following terrain/exit effects, not automatically to the preceding heavy obscurement. Failed exit saves pull toward the center.

source:
你将海底的一个随机20尺边长立方体的海水传送至施法距离内你能看见的区域。这些海水会如同被容器盛放一般保持其立方体形状。生物可以如常出入这片水体。
当法术结束时，海水失去其形状，坠落地面并向外扩散。此时任何处于水中的生物会被冲向随机方向30尺远。
target:
You teleport a random 20-foot Cube of seawater from the ocean floor to an area you can see within range. The water holds its cubic shape as though contained in a vessel. Creatures can enter and leave the water normally.
When the spell ends, the seawater loses its shape, falls to the ground, and spreads outward. Any creature in the water at that time is swept 30 feet in a random direction.
note: Same-row N437 confirms Conjure Ocean. The random source volume, maintained shape, normal passage, and random-direction ending displacement all remain.

source:
你创造出五个1尺见方的魔法力场，被称为达良之块。每个达良之块出现在施法距离内你选择的不同的未被占据空间中，并被魔法固定在原位。这些方块对所有生物都是隐形的，除了你和你在施法时指定的生物。能看见达良之块的生物（包括受到识破隐形影响或拥有真实视觉的生物）会看到由透明的深绿色光芒构成的发光立方体。
固定在空中的方块可以承载最多5,000磅的重量。超过这个重量会导致方块坠落。生物可以使用一个动作进行一次对抗你法术豁免DC的力量检定，成功则可以将固定的方块移动最多10尺。
升环施法。使用四环或更高法术位施展该法术时，每比三环高一环可以额外创造两个达良之块。
target:
You create five 1-foot-square fields of magical force known as Dara Blocks. Each block appears in a different unoccupied space you choose within range and is magically fixed in place. The blocks are invisible to all creatures except you and creatures you designate when casting the spell. Creatures able to see the blocks, including those affected by See Invisibility or possessing Truesight, see glowing cubes of transparent, dark green light.
A block fixed in the air can support up to 5,000 pounds. Exceeding that weight causes it to fall. A creature can use an action to make a Strength check against your spell save DC, moving a fixed block up to 10 feet on a success.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of fourth level or higher, you can create two additional Dara Blocks for each slot level above third.
note: Same-row N438 confirms Dara Blocks. The source first gives a 1-foot-square description and later calls the shapes cubes; both descriptions remain. Visibility exceptions, weight limit, movement check, and scaling are complete.

source: 你召唤出一股庞大的发光能量，缠绕住施法距离内的一个飞行生物，并试图将其从空中拽下。目标必须进行一次敏捷豁免。若豁免失败，目标会被拽至地面并受到正常的坠落伤害（每下落10尺受到1d6点钝击伤害，最高不超过20d6）。若豁免成功，该生物只下落一半距离且不受到伤害。
target: You conjure a mass of glowing energy that coils around a flying creature within range and tries to drag it from the sky. The target must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, it is pulled to the ground and takes normal falling damage: 1d6 Bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet fallen, to a maximum of 20d6. On a successful save, it falls only half the distance and takes no damage.
note: Same-row N440 confirms Plummet. Normal falling damage applies only on failure; success still moves the creature half the distance without damage.

source:
你在施法距离内的地面上一处空位召唤出一口铸铁锅。所有在锅子20尺范围内、未被穿戴或携带且重量不超过10磅的物体都会立即被吸入波格莫的奇异容器中，无论这些物体看起来是否能装得下。所有物体都会被储存在锅中的异次元空间内，直到法术结束。当法术结束时，锅子消失，其中储存的物体会出现在锅子原来所在的位置。
在法术持续时间内，锅子保持密封状态，其中的物体在法术结束前无法被取出。锅子宽1尺，高1尺。它可以轻易被移动或携带，无论其中装了多少物体，锅子始终保持15磅重。锅子免疫所有伤害，但可以被解除魔法解除。
target:
You conjure a cast-iron pot in an unoccupied space on the ground within range. All objects within 20 feet of the pot that aren't worn or carried and weigh no more than 10 pounds are immediately sucked into Pogmo's strange vessel, whether or not they appear able to fit. The objects are stored in an extradimensional space inside the pot until the spell ends. When the spell ends, the pot disappears and the stored objects appear where it stood.
For the duration, the pot remains sealed, and its contents can't be removed before the spell ends. The pot is 1 foot wide and 1 foot high. It is easy to move or carry and always weighs 15 pounds, regardless of how many objects it contains. It is immune to all damage, but Dispel Magic can dispel it.
note: Same-row N441 confirms Pogmo's Pot. Per-object weight eligibility, fixed pot weight, inaccessible storage, ending placement, and dispelling exception are complete.

source:
一簇茂密的蔬菜叶片突然从你施法距离内一处你能看见的未被占据空间的地面上生长而出。以一个附赠动作，生物可以将这些叶片从地面拔出，显露出一根按照你选择的形状长成刀刃状的根茎蔬菜。在法术持续时间内，生物可以将这把蔬菜刀刃作为一件它拥有熟练项的近战武器使用。该刀刃命中时造成1d12挥砍伤害（如常将你的属性调整值加入伤害掷骰），且具有灵巧属性。
此外，在后续回合中，持握者或其盟友可以使用一个附赠动作从刀刃上咬下一口。这么做会治疗该生物等同于刀刃伤害骰+你的施法关键属性调整值的生命值。一旦有生物从刀刃上咬下一口，其伤害骰降低一级——例如从d12降至d10。如果刀刃的伤害骰降低到d4以下，它就会被摧毁，且法术提前结束。
target:
A thick cluster of vegetable leaves suddenly grows from the ground in an unoccupied space you can see within range. As a Bonus Action, a creature can pull the leaves from the ground, revealing a root vegetable grown into a blade of a shape you choose. For the duration, a creature can use the vegetable blade as a melee weapon with which it has proficiency. The blade deals 1d12 Slashing damage on a hit, adding your ability modifier to the damage roll as normal, and has the Finesse property.
In addition, on later turns, the wielder or an ally can use a Bonus Action to take a bite from the blade. Doing so restores that creature's Hit Points by an amount equal to the blade's damage die + your spellcasting ability modifier. Each time a creature bites the blade, its damage die decreases by one step, for example from d12 to d10. If its damage die falls below d4, the blade is destroyed and the spell ends early.
note: Same-row N442 confirms Vegetable Blade. Both Bonus Action uses, proficiency wording, Finesse, and every die reduction remain. The source says your ability modifier in weapon damage and your spellcasting ability modifier in healing; the caster/wielder wording is not silently rewritten.

source:
你将黑灰色的腐烂触须投向施法距离内一个你可见的生物。随后，三条触须从该目标跃向你选择的至多三个其他目标，每个目标都必须在第一个目标的30尺范围内。目标可以是生物或非魔法的非生物植物，例如树木或灌木。无论哪种情况，每个目标只能被其中一条触须选定为目标。 
若目标为生物，则其必须进行一次体质豁免。若豁免失败，则目标受到3d8暗蚀伤害，并在持续时间内陷入中毒状态。若豁免成功，则目标仅受到一半伤害。以这种方式中毒的生物会在其每个回合开始时受到1d8暗蚀伤害。中毒的生物在其每个回合结束时重复该豁免，豁免成功则终止自身该法术。 
植物生物自动失败于初始豁免检定，非魔法的非生物植物则直接枯萎死亡。 
升环施法。使用的法术位每比三环高一环，就会有一根额外的触须从第一个目标跳跃到另一个目标。
target:
You hurl black-gray tendrils of decay at a creature you can see within range. Three tendrils then leap from that target to up to three other targets you choose, each of which must be within 30 feet of the first target. Targets can be creatures or nonmagical plants that aren't creatures, such as trees or shrubs. In either case, each target can be targeted by only one tendril.
A creature target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 3d8 Necrotic damage and is Poisoned for the duration. On a successful save, it takes only half as much damage. A creature Poisoned in this way takes 1d8 Necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns. At the end of each of its turns, it repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success.
Plant creatures automatically fail the initial saving throw, while nonmagical plants that aren't creatures simply wither and die.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: One additional tendril leaps from the first target to another target for each spell slot level above third.
note: Same-row N443 confirms Creeping Rot. Initial target, branching target categories, no-repeat targeting, failed-save-only Poisoned/ongoing damage, Plant exceptions, and extra-branch scaling are retained.

source:
一道血浪从源自你的15尺光环区域内席卷而出。血浪中每个你选择的生物都必须进行一次敏捷豁免，豁免失败则受到3d10暗蚀伤害，豁免成功则受到一半伤害。 
如果你至少伤害了一个小型或更大的生物，则该光环区域内一个你选择的可见生物会恢复等于该伤害掷骰一半的生命值。 
升环施法。使用的法术位每比三环高一环，伤害就增加1d10。
target:
A wave of blood sweeps outward through a 15-foot Emanation originating from you. Each creature you choose in the wave must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d10 Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
If you damage at least one Small or larger creature, one creature you choose and can see in the Emanation regains Hit Points equal to half the damage roll.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: The damage increases by 1d10 for each spell slot level above third.
note: Same-row N444 confirms Crimson Harvest. Healing requires damaging at least one Small-or-larger creature and uses half the damage roll, not half the total damage dealt to all targets.

source:
你触碰一处固定表面，并标示一个能令扭曲生物感到痛苦的符号。一个隐形的30尺球状区域从你触碰的点扩展而出。球状区域内的每个异怪、妖精、邪魔、怪兽或亡灵会在属性检定和攻击检定中具有劣势。当一个受影响的生物在一个回合内首次进入该区域或在该区域内开始其回合时，它必须进行一次感知豁免，豁免失败则陷入恐慌状态，直至其下一回合开始。 
升环施法。如果你使用四环（至多1小时）或五环（至多8小时）法术位施展此法术，你可以维持更长时间的专注。使用六环及更高环阶的法术位施展此法术时，此法术无需专注，并且持续时间变为24小时。
target:
You touch a fixed surface and mark it with a symbol that torments twisted creatures. An invisible 30-foot Sphere extends from the point you touch. Every Aberration, Fey, Fiend, Monstrosity, or Undead in the Sphere has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls. When an affected creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it is Frightened until the start of its next turn.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: You can maintain Concentration for longer when you use a fourth-level slot, up to 1 hour, or a fifth-level slot, up to 8 hours. With a slot of sixth level or higher, the spell doesn't require Concentration and lasts for 24 hours.
note: Same-row N445 confirms Crooked Ward. All five creature types, both trigger events, and the three duration/Concentration tiers remain. The source calls the area a 30-foot Sphere without explicitly saying radius or diameter; that omission is retained.

source:
你创造出一把在持续时间内持续存在的幽灵镰刀，并且可以攻击你的敌人。镰刀悬浮出现于你的空间内并跟随你移动。当你施展此法术时，以及在你每个回合内作为附赠动作，你可以指示它飞向并打击你周边30尺范围内的一个生物。进行一次远程法术攻击。命中时，目标受到2d8暗蚀伤害，并且你获得等于所造成伤害一半的临时生命值。镰刀命中或失手后，会返回并悬浮在你的空间内。 
升环施法。使用的法术位每比三环高一环，伤害就增加1d8。
target:
You create a spectral sickle that lasts for the duration and can attack your enemies. It appears hovering in your space and moves with you. When you cast the spell, and as a Bonus Action on each of your turns, you can direct it to fly toward and strike a creature within 30 feet of you. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 2d8 Necrotic damage, and you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to half the damage dealt. After the sickle hits or misses, it returns to hover in your space.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above third.
note: Same-row N446 confirms Culling Sickle. Initial and Bonus Action attacks, return on hit or miss, and Temporary Hit Points based on damage dealt remain.

source:
你全神贯注于一个你熟悉且与你处于同一存在位面的生物。目标必须进行一次感知豁免，豁免失败则在持续时间内被诅咒。一旦目标为对抗该法术而进行的豁免检定失败，则在接下来24小时内，你无法在仪式施展该法术时再次以其为目标。 
被诅咒期间，目标会听到萦绕心头的不和谐音乐，并且在所有D20检定中具有劣势。目标在一个回合内首次失败于一次D20检定时，它会以既无优势也无劣势的方式重复对抗此法术的豁免检定，豁免成功则提前终止该法术。
target:
You focus on a creature you are familiar with on the same plane of existence as you. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it is cursed for the duration. Once the target fails a save against this spell, you can't target it again by casting this spell as a Ritual for the next 24 hours.
While cursed, the target hears haunting, discordant music and has Disadvantage on all D20 Tests. The first time on a turn that it fails a D20 Test, it repeats the saving throw against this spell with neither Advantage nor Disadvantage, ending the spell early on a success.
note: Same-row N447 confirms Cursed Cacophony. The 24-hour restriction follows a failed spell save and applies specifically to Ritual targeting. The repeat save occurs on the first failed D20 Test of a turn and suppresses both Advantage and Disadvantage.

source:
你呼唤丰收之月的光辉，照亮以施法距离内一点为源点的20尺球状区域。该区域会沐浴在银色的微光光照下。在该光照下具有隐形状态的生物和物件会以半透明的闪烁影像形式变得可见。当你的一位盟友位于该光照下时，它可以使用附赠动作吸收部分光辉，获得2d6临时生命值。 
升环施法。使用的法术位每比三环高一环，临时生命值就增加1d6。
target:
You call on the radiance of the harvest moon to illuminate a 20-foot Sphere originating from a point within range. The area is bathed in silvery Dim Light. Invisible creatures and objects in this light become visible as translucent, shimmering images. While one of your allies is in the light, it can use a Bonus Action to absorb some of the radiance and gain 2d6 Temporary Hit Points.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: The Temporary Hit Points increase by 1d6 for each spell slot level above third.
note: Same-row N448 confirms Harvest Moonglow. The source's 20-foot Sphere has no explicit radius/diameter label. Visibility revelation and allies' Bonus Action Temporary Hit Points are retained without adding a once-only limit.

source: 施法距离内一个你可见的生物必须进行一次感知豁免，豁免失败则其心智将被完全孤立的恐惧所笼罩。在持续时间内，其他所有生物都对目标具有隐形状态，目标无法看穿此状态——即便使用盲视、真实视觉或如同法术识破隐形See Invisibility之类的魔法——并且目标无法通过任何其他感官感知其他生物。目标会在移动时绕开其他生物，或以其他方式合理化地不穿过其他生物所占据的空间（例如，如果另一个生物挡在路上，目标会认为那是一扇关着的门或是一堵墙）。目标仍然能感受到疼痛，但无法确定任何由其他生物所造成的伤害的来源。目标在其每个回合结束时重复该豁免，豁免成功则终止自身该法术。
target: A creature you can see within range must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, its mind is overwhelmed by the terror of complete isolation. For the duration, all other creatures are Invisible to the target, and it can't see through this condition even with Blindsight, Truesight, or magic such as See Invisibility. It also can't perceive other creatures with any other sense. When moving, the target goes around other creatures or otherwise rationalizes not passing through the spaces they occupy. For example, if another creature blocks its path, the target believes a closed door or a wall is there. The target can still feel pain but can't identify the source of damage caused by other creatures. At the end of each of its turns, it repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success.
note: Same-row N449 confirms Isolation. The entire all-senses restriction, explicit countermeasure exclusions, movement rationalization/example, pain distinction, and repeat save remain.

source: 你触碰一个在过去1分钟内死亡的生物，并将你的生命精粹转移到它体内。目标以等于你当前生命值总值的生命值复活。你立即降至0生命值（无法以任何方式阻止），并获得两次失败的死亡豁免检定，且你必须立即进行一次死亡豁免。直至你进行这次死亡豁免之前，你无法恢复生命值或变得伤势稳定。
target: You touch a creature that died within the last 1 minute and transfer your life essence into it. The target returns to life with Hit Points equal to your current Hit Point total. You immediately drop to 0 Hit Points, which can't be prevented by any means, gain two failed Death Saving Throws, and must immediately make a Death Saving Throw. You can't regain Hit Points or become Stable until you make that save.
note: Same-row N450 confirms Martyr. Target revival uses current HP; the caster's unavoidable drop, two failed saves, immediate save, and temporary prohibition on healing/stabilizing are all retained.

source: 你召唤出一片稀薄迷雾，汲取以施法距离内一点为中心的20尺球状区域内的欢乐与活力。在迷雾出现时位于其中，或在一个回合内首次进入迷雾或在迷雾内结束自己回合的每个生物，都必须进行一次魅力豁免，豁免失败则会充满深深的忧郁，直至其下一回合结束。受影响生物的速度减半，其攻击检定具有劣势，并且其所有伤害掷骰都会减去1d8。
target: You conjure a thin mist that drains joy and vitality from a 20-foot Sphere centered on a point within range. Each creature in the mist when it appears, entering the mist for the first time on a turn, or ending its turn there must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, it is filled with deep melancholy until the end of its next turn. An affected creature's Speed is halved, it has Disadvantage on attack rolls, and it subtracts 1d8 from all its damage rolls.
note: Same-row N451 confirms Mist of Mourning. All three timing triggers and all three failed-save penalties are retained. The source does not explicitly label the Sphere's dimension as radius or diameter.

source: 你以施法距离内一点为中心，创造出一个闪烁微弱光芒的20尺球状区域。你和你选择的至多等于你施法属性调整值的生物（至少1个其他生物）可以从该球状区域吸收赋权魔法。当任何被选中的生物在该区域内完成一次长休时，球状区域消失，这些生物获得2d10临时生命值，并且在剩余持续时间内，他们在使用其拥有技能熟练的魅力检定中具有优势。未在球状区域内完成一次长休的被选中生物不会获得任何增益。
context: column:M;spell:Sanctum of the Flock;book:歪曲之月;level:3
target: You create a faintly shimmering 20-foot Sphere centered on a point within range. You and a number of creatures you choose up to your spellcasting ability modifier, with a minimum of 1 other creature, can draw empowering magic from the Sphere. When any chosen creature finishes a Long Rest in the area, the Sphere disappears, and those creatures gain 2d10 Temporary Hit Points and, for the remaining duration, Advantage on Charisma checks that use a skill in which they have proficiency. Chosen creatures that haven't finished a Long Rest in the Sphere gain no benefit.
note: Same-row N452 confirms Sanctum of the Flock. The source says any chosen creature finishing a Long Rest makes the Sphere disappear, then excludes those who haven't finished; that timing is preserved rather than changed to waiting for everyone. The caster-plus-other-creatures count and minimum remain.

source:
猩红光芒在以施法距离内一点为中心的20尺半径，60尺高的柱状区域内倾泻而下。该区域内每个非构装非亡灵生物都必须进行一次体质豁免，豁免失败则受到4d10暗蚀伤害，豁免成功则受到一半伤害。该区域内的构装与亡灵会恢复4d10生命值。 
如果该法术的任何区域与任何三环或更低环阶法术创造的黑暗区域重叠，则这些造暗的法术将被解除。 
升环施法。使用的法术位每比三环高一环，伤害就增加1d10，可被解除的法术的环阶就增加一。
target:
Scarlet light pours down in a Cylinder with a radius of 20 feet and a height of 60 feet, centered on a point within range. Each creature in the area that is neither a Construct nor Undead must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 4d10 Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Constructs and Undead in the area regain 4d10 Hit Points.
If any part of this spell's area overlaps an area of Darkness created by a spell of third level or lower, the spells creating that Darkness are dispelled.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: The damage increases by 1d10, and the level of spells that can be dispelled increases by one, for each spell slot level above third.
note: Same-row N453 confirms Scarlet Dawn. The living-creature damage and Construct/Undead healing branches are distinct. Scaling explicitly increases damage and the dispelling threshold, not the separately stated healing.

source:
你通过阴影汲取源自你的15尺光环区域内生物的活力与自我意识。当你施展该法术时，你可以指定某些生物不受其影响。每当其他生物进入该光环或在其中开始其回合，或当该光环进入生物的占据空间时，该生物必须进行一次魅力豁免。若豁免失败，则该生物受到2d6暗蚀伤害，并且其攻击检定和属性检定会具有劣势，直至其下一回合结束。若豁免成功，则该生物仅受到一半伤害。一名生物一个回合内只进行一次该豁免。 
升环施法。使用的法术位每比三环高一环，伤害就增加1d6。
target:
Through shadow, you drain vitality and self-awareness from creatures in a 15-foot Emanation originating from you. When you cast the spell, you can designate creatures to be unaffected. Whenever another creature enters the Emanation or starts its turn there, or the Emanation enters a creature's space, that creature must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 2d6 Necrotic damage and has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, it takes only half as much damage. A creature makes this save only once per turn.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above third.
note: Same-row N454 confirms Shadow Drain. All three entry/start triggers, chosen exemptions, once-per-turn save limit, and failed-save-only penalties remain.

source: 你显现地狱一角。在法术持续时间内，你令施法距离内一点为中心的半径15尺球状区域内充斥着黑暗、硫磺与爆裂火焰。位于其30尺内的生物可以听见地狱火云中回荡着的被诅咒灵魂的悲鸣。光照——包括魔法光源——无法照亮火云，任何完全身处区域内的生物陷入目盲。火云扭曲了时空，使火云所在区域变为困难地形。在区域内开始其回合的生物将受到3d6火焰伤害。在区域内结束其回合的生物必须成功通过一次感知豁免，否则将因魔音贯脑受到3d6心灵伤害。
target: You manifest a fragment of Hell. For the duration, a Sphere with a radius of 15 feet centered on a point within range fills with darkness, brimstone, and bursting flames. Creatures within 30 feet of it can hear the lamentations of damned souls echoing in the infernal cloud. No light, including magical light, can illuminate the cloud, and any creature entirely inside the area is Blinded. The cloud warps space and time, making its area Difficult Terrain. A creature that starts its turn in the area takes 3d6 Fire damage. A creature that ends its turn there must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or take 3d6 Psychic damage as demonic sounds assail its mind.
note: Same-row N455 confirms Mote of Hell. The two damage timings remain distinct: automatic Fire at turn start, failed Wisdom save for Psychic at turn end. Sound radius, light exclusion, and full-entry Blinded condition are complete.

source:
你的双臂会变成强有力的翅膀，你的手指变成长而优美的羽毛。此法术的效果持续1分钟，之后羽毛会逐渐脱落、当你的双臂恢复原状时，你会轻轻地漂浮到地面上。这个法术会给施法者带来以下增益：
以一个附赠动作，你可以飞行至多等同于你移动速度两倍的距离。你必须在移动结束后着陆，不过在此法术生效时，你不会受到坠落伤害，因为你的羽毛手臂会将你轻轻的带到地面上。
你可以用有力的羽臂将自己向上推，距离相当于你移动速度的一半。
在你的回合中可以使用一次此效果，并且可以与普通跳跃同时使用。
坠落时，你可以利用反作用力收紧双臂，在风中滑行。你可以向任何方向至多等同你移动速度的距离飞行，并选择落脚点。
在进行跳远或跳高时，你在所有的运动检定中具有优势。跳跃前不需要移动10尺，跳远的距离是正常情况下的三倍。
要使用此法术，你的双手必须必须没有持有盾牌和重型武器，也不能超载。
context: column:M;spell:Feathered Reach;book:谦卑林战役设定集;level:3
target:
Your arms become powerful wings, and your fingers turn into long, graceful feathers. The spell's effect lasts for 1 minute, after which the feathers gradually fall away. As your arms return to normal, you drift gently to the ground. The spell grants the caster the following benefits:
As a Bonus Action, you can fly a distance up to twice your Speed. You must land at the end of this movement, but while the spell is active, you take no falling damage because your feathered arms carry you gently to the ground.
You can propel yourself upward with your powerful wing-arms a distance equal to half your Speed.
You can use this effect once on your turn and can combine it with a normal jump.
While falling, you can draw your arms inward and use the reaction force to glide on the wind. You can fly up to your Speed in any direction and choose where to land.
You have Advantage on all Athletics checks made for a Long Jump or High Jump. You don't need to move 10 feet before jumping, and your Long Jump distance is three times normal.
To use this spell, your hands must not be holding shields or Heavy weapons, and you must not be overloaded.
note: Same-row N456 confirms Feathered Reach. All seven lines and every movement mode/limit remain. The falling sentence says physical reaction force, not the game term Reaction; no action cost is invented. The source repeats must in the final restriction; its single requirement is stated once. Overloaded remains as supplied without inventing a mechanical threshold.

source:
你将周围半径15尺，高15尺的区域笼罩在一个球形的点缀着微星的夜空中。暮色掩盖了你的盟友，却清晰地照亮了你的敌人。
受此法术影响的区域会因魔法阴影处于轻微遮蔽，其中的小星座柔和地闪烁。除了这些星星之外，只有由三环或更高的法术产生的光才能照亮球内的任何区域。非魔法光照在球体内不起作用，所有其他形式的魔法光照只能在其5尺内提供微光光照。
施放此法术时，你可以指定任意数量的生物在球体内被超自然的阴影遮蔽。被选择的生物在球体内时，在敏捷（隐匿）检定上具有优势，并可在任何时候尝试躲藏。在该法术范围外生物在对其感知（察觉）检定上具有劣势。
该区域内的所有其他生物都会被微缩星星的光芒所晕眩，导致它在球体内部的所有察觉检定具有劣势。当这些生物首次进入法术区域，或在该区域开始回合时、其必须进行一次感知豁免，否则就会陷入目盲，直到其回合结束。
context: column:M;spell:Globe of Twilight;book:谦卑林战役设定集;level:3
target:
You enclose the area around you, with a radius of 15 feet and a height of 15 feet, in a globe of night sky dotted with tiny stars. The twilight conceals your allies while clearly illuminating your enemies.
Magical shadows make the spell's area Lightly Obscured, with small constellations twinkling softly within it. Apart from these stars, only light produced by spells of third level or higher can illuminate any area inside the globe. Nonmagical light doesn't function inside it, and all other forms of magical light provide only Dim Light within 5 feet of their sources.
When you cast the spell, you can designate any number of creatures to be concealed by supernatural shadows within the globe. While inside, chosen creatures have Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks and can attempt to Hide at any time. Creatures outside the spell's area have Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks to perceive them.
